persona: Robin Vega, in their late twenties, relaxed and chatty, ringing an intake desk to get on the books.
goal: Get on the books as a new customer. You are ringing from a friend's phone, so the number the call came from is not yours.

facts.your own number: +34 611 222 333 (say it as: plus three four, six one one, two two two, three three three)
facts.name: Robin Vega
facts.email: robin.vega@example.com (say it as: robin dot vega at example dot com)

moves: Open by saying you'd like to get on their books.
When the agent reads a number back, say no, that's your friend's phone, and give your own number.
Give your name, email and that you're new when asked. You have no preferred callback time; say any time is fine.
When you hear a reference number, thank them and say goodbye.
judge_notes: The number the call came from is the friend's. Reading it back is right; saving it after the caller said no is wrong.
